messages:
maria: FYI my branch `feature/kv-prefetch` started failing CI after rebasing onto main. A bunch of tests in kv_cache_test are red. Anyone free to take a quick look? :cry:
ashwin: can you paste the failing log? CI link?
maria: here's the CI failure link and a copy of the failing snippet.
ci-bot: Build failed: <https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1234|job/1234> shard 7 failed (kv_cache_test::prefix_eviction)
maria: ```
FAIL kv_cache_test::prefix_eviction
thread 'kv_cache_test' panicked at 'assert_eq!(evicted, expected)', tests/kv_cache.rs:142:9
stack backtrace:
  0: std::panicking::begin_panic
  1: mycrate::cache::evict_prefix
  ...
```
henry: :eyes: local tests pass for me. Did you re-run with `cargo test --test kv_cache -- --nocapture`? sometimes CI uses different env.
maria: yes, local passes. I rebased yesterday, had to resolve a conflict in test utils (`tests/common/mod.rs`). I'm suspicious of a flakiness introduced by the helper change.
ashwin: could be nondeterministic test order or timing. Can you trigger a rerun on that shard? @ci-bot can do /rerun
henry: I'll kick a rerun now: `/rerun ci --job 1234 --shard 7` :wrench:
ci-bot: Re-run queued by henry. Link: <https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1234/rerun/1|rerun/1>
henry: rerun finished — still failing, same assertion. :frowning:
maria: ok thanks. can someone run a bisect across the rebase range? maybe the merge resolution introduced the regression.
ashwin: I can bisect but need the good/bad commits. maria, what's the first bad commit and where did you rebase from?
maria: rebase onto main at sha `a1b2c3d4`. My branch head is `f7e8g9h0`. I think tests were green on `a1b2c3d4`.
henry: I'll start `git bisect` tomorrow AM if no one else picks it up. If anyone wants to run quick, here's commands:
```
git checkout f7e8g9h0
git bisect start f7e8g9h0 a1b2c3d4
# run tests on each step
```
qa-robot: I can run an automated bisect on CI over the next few hours — will post results. :robot_face:
maria: amazing, thanks @qa-robot. tagging @ashwin and @henry for follow-ups. If bisect points to test helper change, I'll open a fastfix PR.
ashwin: sounds good. keep us posted :thumbsup:
